# Lifting finite nested joint plans

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Where configurations a description identifies match parts into ones it identifies and leaves are read correctly through it, a finite plan is realized at a description exactly where it is realized at each configuration so described; plans lift through a description exactly where it matches parts.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Description form: where configurations a description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies and the leaves are read correctly through it, a finite nested joint plan is realized at the description of a configuration exactly where it is realized at that configuration; plans whose leaves are descriptions lift through a description exactly where configurations it identifies match parts. Code form: through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving configurations passing the same tests one code, with the leaves read correctly, the pairs of parts compact and the tests stable, the coded whole realizes a finite nested joint plan exactly where the native whole realizes it.

Canonical source: [JointCorrespondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JointCorrespondence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Description form: MatchesParts through the description and pointwise leaf correctness. Code form: JointCompact, TestsStable, Exact, Reduced and pointwise leaf correctness. Plans are finite binary nestings.

Each node retains a common witness; leaf identities and cross-branch sharing are not automatically fixed by code existence.

The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Where configurations a description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies and the leaves are read correctly, a description realizes a nested plan exactly where every configuration it describes does (JointPlan.realizes_image_iff), and plans lifting from every configuration is matching parts (JointPlan.plans_lift_iff). So joint_plan_lifts holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (joint_plan_lifts_of_stable); excluded middle gives stability, and without it the classical step is exactly excluded middle.
